access.token_owner: each user's own Hugging Face account (HF_TOKEN)

deletion_obligations: On access revocation or project end, delete data/raw/ctrate and every derivative (data/processed/ctrate/*, caches, features).
No redistribution: no CT-RATE row, report or volume is committed to this repository.

expected_counts.source: provider-stated, dataset README at the pinned revision (unverified until an authorized download)

expected_files.checksum_note: LFS file: git_blob_sha1 is the pointer-file oid; the LFS sha256 is masked in the unauthenticated API, so verify checks size only until it is recorded after an authorized download.

split_policy.method: dev = round(0.10*N_train_patients) train patients with the lowest sha256(f'{seed}:{patient_key}'); official valid is the sealed test split

summary: Academic, research and educational use only; no commercial use without permission.
Comply with privacy law (GDPR/HIPAA); no re-identification.
Cite the dataset; no ownership claims.
No redistribution of the dataset or any portion of it.
Access may be revoked and terms may change.

time_convention.name: ctrate_synthetic_anchor_v1
time_convention.note: CT-RATE has no clinical timestamps. The anchor is a sentinel, never a real clinical time. Volume <= report < labels; only volumes are reader input. One case = one scan; no cross-scan evidence.

volume_root_decision: open: train vs train_fixed to be decided after reading the gated dataset/data_correction_note.md
